title: Ancient Stupa Collapses at Chiang Mai Temple
description: CHIANG MAI – Worshipers and local villagers in northern Thailand watched in shock on Sunday morning as the towering spire of a revered Buddhist stupa broke apart and crashed down without warning. The sudden structural failure occurred at approximately 9:45 AM at Wat Mai Nong Hoi, located in Doi Lo District of Chiang Mai Province.
